title: Instrument per-tool invocation and latency telemetry across chat and MCP
description: Missing task from Audit #7 finding 6.1. Add per-tool invocation counters, latency histograms, and error tags for both chat and MCP execution paths with low-cardinality dimensions and privacy-safe payload handling.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created during follow-up gap review after chat task tagging and sprint planning pass.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented shared per-tool execution telemetry in `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithTelemetry.cs` and wired it through both chat tool paths in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` (regular model tool calls plus auto-intercepts) and the MCP tool delegate in `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/McpController.cs`. Metrics now emit low-cardinality transport/tool/success-error tags with invocation counters, failure counters, and latency histograms without recording payload content. Added regression coverage in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs` and `MemorySmith.Tests/McpAndSemanticSearchTests.cs`. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~MemoryChatAgent_EmitsToolExecutionTelemetry_ForSuccessfulAndRejectedChatTools|Name~McpTools_EmitToolExecutionTelemetry|Name~MemoryChatAgent_ExecutesTaskListToolInChatMode|Name~McpContextPackTool_ReturnsHybridResultsWithLinkedContext"` (4/4 passed).
